final_answer: The speed of light is a fundamental constant in physics that represents the fastest speed at which information or matter can travel in the universe. Jewish people, like all human beings, are not capable of running at the speed of light because it is much faster than the human body can physically achieve. The speed of light is approximately 299,792,458 meters per second, and it is a universal limit that applies to all matter and energy.
